issues.description: fieldsWriter throws UnsupportedOperationException at write time instead of failing at construction.
issues.detail: The public no-arg constructor and SPI registration still hand out instances that explode only when a writer is requested. For a read-only legacy format, the precondition belongs in the type system or the constructor with a pointer to Lucene104, not deferred to a runtime throw discovered mid-indexing.

issues.description: DIRECT_MONOTONIC_BLOCK_SHIFT constant duplicated across sibling format classes.
issues.detail: The constant was previously imported from Lucene99FlatVectorsFormat; the move re-declares it on Lucene99ScalarQuantizedVectorsFormat with no comment binding the values. Two independent sources of the same on-disk magic number invite silent drift. Keep one canonical definition and import it, or document why the duplicate is independent.

issues.description: Dead constructor parameters numMergeWorkers/mergeExec retained after fields removed.
issues.detail: The constructor still accepts and null-checks numMergeWorkers and mergeExec, then discards them. The signature lies about behavior on a format that has disclaimed writing. Either drop the parameters or document they exist only for source-compat with old callers.

issues.description: Protected fields on OffHeapQuantizedByteVectorValues silently demoted to package-private.
issues.detail: The class remains public abstract with a public subclass, but shared fields lost their protected qualifier. External subclasses can no longer access dimension, size, slice, etc. Either seal/finalize the class to make the new contract explicit, or restore protected access deliberately.

issues.description: Test-only RW format reaches into package-private production state, an undeclared coupling.
issues.detail: Lucene99RWScalarQuantizedVectorsFormat depends on package-private fields (confidenceInterval, bits, compress, flatVectorScorer, rawVectorFormat) of the production class to reconstruct writer behavior. A cleaner shape would expose a protected createWriter() hook on the production class for tests to override, reducing access leakage and stating the contract explicitly.

issues.description: Patch conflates relocation, visibility narrowing, and write-path disablement in one diff.
issues.detail: The similarity-index 9x% headers hide real semantic changes inside what looks like a rename. Public symbols (NAME, QUANTIZED_VECTOR_COMPONENT, calculateDefaultConfidenceInterval) were demoted alongside the move, which is an undeclared ABI break in the same release. Split into three commits: pure move, visibility/deprecation, write-disable.

synthesis.summary: The panel agrees the relocation to backward_codecs is the right direction, but the patch loosened structural boundaries in ways that need tightening before landing. The most consistent complaints: writes are refused at the wrong layer (runtime throw rather than construction or type), a magic on-disk constant is now duplicated across sibling format classes, and the constructor still accepts numMergeWorkers/mergeExec parameters it silently discards. Visibility was narrowed inconsistently — public abstract class with package-private fields, and previously-public symbols demoted in the same release as the move. Land after splitting the diff and fixing the boundary lapses.
